capabilities: Create, edit, and delete website bookmarks in plugin settings
Open bookmarks from ribbon icons or command palette commands
Customize bookmark icons with Lucide icon names
Insert selected editor text into bookmark URLs via a {{selection}} placeholder
extras: Bookmarks changes require an Obsidian reload to take effect; the {{selection}} placeholder only reads selections from Markdown editors, not embedded webviews.
intentEvidence: create and manage bookmarks for websites when using Obsidian's built-in web viewer
problem: Obsidian's built-in Web viewer has no way to save and quickly revisit websites you open in it.
summary: Bookmark manager for Obsidian's built-in Web viewer that stores website bookmarks and opens them from the ribbon or command palette.
